chapter: The Path of the Treasure-Seeker... Part II?
act_title: The Path of the Treasure-Seeker... Part II?

quests.title: The Path of the Treasure-Seeker... Part II?

dialogue.t: *sigh* Seriously, am I some sort of Seelie magnet?
You're... the Traveler? Oh my, your timing is impeccable!
Listen, I've got an earnest proposal. A profitable proposal, too. Interested, by any chance?

dialogue.sit: Not going to keep it to yourself?

dialogue.t: Ah, come on, no need to be on your guard. Come on, I'm just an ordinary guy looking to make some money in Inazuma.
But of course, Inazuma's a closed country, right? So I got together with some friends to come up with a plan. I got myself a boat that way, and prepared to cross the ocean and get to Inazuma.
*sigh* But the weather grew stranger the closer I drew to Inazuma. The thunder peeled and the storms roared...
And bam! One lightning bolt from the sky hit my boat dead on, wrecking it, and I was hurled into the sea.
Waves came crashing in. I got a few mouthfuls of seawater as I struggled before fainting. When I came to again, I was lying on the beach.
Hahaha, you can say that I've always been this way.
And, hmmm, how should I put this? So I had a look around once I'd reached shore, and...
I met this little fellow.
A Treasure-Seeking Seelie, to be precise. As the name suggests, they are the best buddies of people who seek treasure.
But for reasons I can't understand, it just decided to quit on me after finding a few treasure sites. Now it just spends its time circling around me.
I've given it some thought, and I reckon that it has gotten sick of my slow rate of unearthing treasure, and is now looking for a new partner.
If you're interested, Traveler, why don't you take up that role?

dialogue.sit: I'm no expert in Seelie communications...

dialogue.t: Haha, it's not an issue, don't worry. I mean, look at this fellow, bouncing with excitement and all — I'd wager it's taken a liking to you!
*cough* Well, more on that later. Either way, wanna try working with this Seelie?
Great! That makes two... no, three of us. Partners!
Take this book with you. The locations I've marked out on them have treasure buried in them somewhere.
But without a Treasure-Seeking Seelie, there's no way I'd be able to find them, so it's up to you, Traveler.

dialogue.sit: And who shall the treasure go to?
Guess we'll split the goods fifty-fifty?

dialogue.t: Well... The items you find themselves are yours — I'll stake no claim on them.
But there's a chance that you'll unearth some Iron Coins while you're looking for treasure...
If you find any of that ancient currency, please bring them to me.
Most people won't take these, but I'll give you a good price for them.
Well then. The books yours, and so's this Seelie.
Happy hunting, Traveler... and here's to our profitable partnership!
*sigh* Seriously, am I some sort of Seelie magnet?
Oh, it's... it's you, Traveler! Fancy meeting you here as well!

dialogue.sit: Oh, you're the guy with the Treasure-Seeking Seelie...

dialogue.t: Come on, it's me, Ulman! We teamed up to look for treasure before, remember?
...Right, the Treasure-Seeking Seelie! You remember that at least, right?

dialogue.sit: Sure. Why are you here in Inazuma?

dialogue.t: Ahem. So, uh... You remember how you found me all those Iron Coins during our last partnership, yes?
I had them sold off and made a tidy sum of Mora myself... Hehe. Thanks for that, by the way.
But as you know, there're always ways and means of spending Mora. I've quite spent the whole amount by now...
Not to mention how I no longer had a Treasure-Seeking Seelie, so there was no chance that I'd be able to find those Iron Coins without further help from you.
So while I was cooking up some other way to finance myself...
...I heard from an, ah, acquaintance that Inazuma's a place chock-full of treasure, so I came here to try my luck.

dialogue.sit: You know this is a closed country, right?

dialogue.t: Yes, yes, of course. Well... Let's just say that I have my ways.
Now, where was I? Right. So I made arrangements with those "friends" of mine and got my hands on a boat for a fee. With that, I made ready to sail to Inazuma.
*sigh* But the weather grew stranger the closer I drew to Inazuma. The thunder peeled and the storms roared...
And bam! One lightning bolt from the sky hit my boat dead on, wrecking it, and I was hurled into the sea.
Waves came crashing in. I got a few mouthfuls of seawater as I struggled before fainting. When I came to again, I was lying on the beach.
Hahaha, you can say that I've always been this way.
And, hmmm, how should I put this? So I had a look around once I'd reached shore, and...
Somehow, I bumped into this little one again, and it helped me find a few treasures, to boot. So I thought, "oh, these must also be Treasure-Seeking Seelie..."
But like the previous bunch, it also got tired after searching a few sites with treasures in them, and now it just circles around me over and over...

dialogue.sit: It's this sort of Seelie again...

dialogue.t: I don't know either. Maybe I'm some sort of Seelie magnet?
Or maybe there's something on my person that attracts them? I don't really get it either...
But either way, now that I'm here, I'm not leaving empty-handed.
According to the information I have, there should still be some treasure around. I've jotted the general areas down in my notebook.
But since this fellow isn't looking too enthusiastic, I'd wager that it would be too tall a task for me...
So, what say you partner up with your old buddy Ulman again, eh, Traveler? Your Treasure-Seeking Seelie should still be raring to go.
Same deal as last time: I'll mark the spots for you, and you'll find the treasure for me. The items you find themselves are yours — I'll stake no claim on them.
But if you find any Iron Coins, just bring those beauties to me, and I'll make sure to give you a good price for 'em.

dialogue.sit: As long as the price is right.

dialogue.t: And it will be, friend, I assure you! We're long-time partners now, you can trust me!
Here, take my notebook. Happy hunting, Traveler, and here's to a profitable partnership!

quests.description: A certain fellow named Ulman is at the Inazuman seaside, puzzling over his present situation…
